title: Natural sunlight driven phototransformation of the expectorant drug ambroxol in fresh waters
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00205B, Paper
Ying Zhang, Xiaoci Li, Jing Chen, Lei Zhou, Ming-bao Feng, JM CHOVELON, Yuefei Ji
Ambroxol (AMB), a widely used expectorant drug, has been ubiquitously detected in aquatic environments due to its limited metabolism in human body. Herein, we systematically investigated the photodegradation of AMB...
